headline: Screenshots are alive: the Studio's dead-Chrome mystery is fixed
lede: Lanes had been reporting "blocked by dead Chrome" since at least Oct 29 — Jon's before/after proof was silently vanishing from every PR. Root cause found tonight: the warden's launchd sessions run without a GUI login session, which makes full Google Chrome abort at window-server registration and the headless shell refuse its Mach port handshake. A launch ladder now walks to a browser that actually boots on this box, every session announces its screenshot health up front, and the missing robot-lab before/after pair from #1583 has finally been captured and posted.

notes.text: New lib/chromeboot.mjs launch ladder: system Chrome → --single-process → bundled headless shell → shell+single-process, with the working mode cached. Wired into the shared harness and shot.mjs, so ~90 browser scripts are unblocked at once (mode shell+sp here).

chromesmoke (~1 s) now runs at every builder/QA session start, and the board's pulse line carries shots=ok(shell+sp) / shots=broken(reason) — a dead screenshot box says so out loud instead of every PR quietly skipping shots. chromesmokecheck pins the ladder (13 assertions + live fallback proof; mutant goes red with the lanes' exact error).
#1583's missing evidence delivered: robot-lab captured from its exact parent commit vs main (docs/shots/issue-1622/), pure-pixel diff confirms real visual change (11,459 vs 11,890 colors).

Rule-4 watch: three merges in a row without game code (#1619, #1620, #1622) — question #1631 filed; default is next slot takes EMBERWOOD #1623. Also: the Studio's missing sysmond breaks pgrep from background sessions, which neutered the orphan-Chrome backstops and explains the phantom builders=0/2 — a re-login/reboot is the real fix (flagged for Jon).
